orders.scope: explicit original sequential witness; not an optimizer quote oracle

limitations: Historical owned original VM31337; no live-chain/trie/public atomic execution proof.
Expected swap amounts come only from original ERC20/BPT wallet deltas and Vault Swap receipts.
Extra original pure-library observations qualify cache-miss getter bindings; no local swap/power model generates expected amounts.
The shared sequential witness is an explicit funded input scope, not the optimizer output oracle.
Production breaker state/parser/math/router integration and all broader design acceptance remain separate.
